subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The shield used by the / warrior have been one / made of strong iron.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **main subject** of the sentence is "**The shield**", which is **singular**.
 
• In part B, the verb "**have been**" is **plural**, but it should agree with the singular subject (**has been**).
 
• The word "**one**" is **unnecessary and incorrect** in this context.
 
• Therefore, the error clearly lies in **part B: "warrior have been one"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The shield used by the warrior **has been made of strong iron**."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: No error** – This is incorrect because a clear subject-verb agreement error exists.
 
• **Option 3: "made of strong iron"** – This part is grammatically correct and needs no change.
 
• **Option 4: "The shield used by the"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not contain any error.
 
• The rule of **subject-verb agreement** requires a **singular verb (has)** for a **singular subject (shield)**.
